title: VEKA - Wikipedia
content: # VEKA. **VEKA AG** is a German extruder of uPVC profiles for use in windows, doors, roller shutters and sliding doors headquartered in Sendenhorst, Germany. Founded in 1967 as a manufacturer of shutters, it currently operates its own extrusion facilities in twelve countries. VEKA was founded in Sendenhorst, West Germany under the name Vekaplast in 1967 and initially produced only roller shutters. Due to growing demand, the company acquired his 115,000 square meters of land on the industrial site in Sendenhorst and built a new extrusion plant there after surpassing his 15,000 square meters of leased plant. In 1983, VEKA decided to increase its exports to foreign markets due to economic stagnation in West Germany, establishing subsidiaries in Spain, France, and the United States within a year. In 1993, VEKA opened a 120,000 square foot recycling center and established a subsidiary, VEKA West, Inc., in Reno, Nevada to serve the western United States. VEKA Holdings Inc. was also established to manage his VEKA operations in the United States.

title: VEKA | Company with family spirit | VEKA Group
content: From Sendenhorst to the whole world - with our 54locations on 4continents including our 23production plants, we are represented worldwide and sell our products internationally. As a family-run company in the second generation, our roots are in Sendenhorst (Münsterland) in Westphalia. Independent subsidiaries on 4continents complete our international presence and provide jobs for around 7,000employees worldwide. With an annual turnover of over 1.5 billion €, of which 80 % is generated abroad on 4continents, the VEKA Group is officially the world market leader in the field of PVC profile systems for windows and doors. With subsidiaries in Europe, Asia, North and South America, we are represented worldwide and provide jobs for around 7,000employees *(data as of December 2024)*. For more than 50 years we have been producing profile systems for windows, doors, roller shutters as well as sliding doors made of PVC. More than 50 years of VEKA. title: Company development & history - VEKA
content: # Future needs origin. > If you want to achieve high employee motivation, you have to give your employees responsibility and you have to trust them. from: "Ein Leben mit Profil" (2005). ## It started with a visionary idea. The origin of the VEKA Group is in Sendenhorst, Westphalia, where our headquarter is still located today. Here it all started, when Heinrich Laumann laid the groundwork for an entrepreneurial success story with his visionary idea and foresight. ## How it all began. Heinrich Laumann took over the company VEKAPLAST in Sendenhorst, which manufactured roller shutters and building profiles with only 8 employees. Heinrich Laumann on the other hand focused on PVC windows as a product of the future. He quickly took initiatives to develop the first window profile system.
